_meta.purpose: Household utility costs and their seasonality, so resident budgets tighten in winter. Tourists do not pay these.
_meta.rule: Blocks named 'derived_*' are calculated by scripts/build_topup.py from the sourced blocks; everything else is copied from the cited source.

sources.npei_tariff: Niagara Peninsula Energy Inc. Tariff of Rates and Charges effective 2026-01-01, OEB EB-2025-0020 — https://www.npei.ca/media/4721/download
sources.oeb_decision: OEB Decision and Rate Order EB-2025-0020 (750 kWh reference customer; ~59,000 customers in Niagara Falls, Lincoln, West Lincoln, Pelham) — https://www.rds.oeb.ca/CMWebDrawer/Record/923364/File/document
sources.oeb_rpp: Ontario Energy Board electricity rates, prices set for 2026-11-01 — https://www.oeb.ca/consumer-information-and-protection/electricity-rates
sources.oer: Ontario Electricity Rebate 15.7% from 2026-11-01 (23.5% before) — CP24 2026-10-19, https://www.cp24.com/local/toronto/2026/10/19/ontarios-electricity-rates-are-falling-this-november-heres-how-much-it-will-cost/ ; 23.5% confirmed on NPEI winter 2025/26 rate sheet https://www.npei.ca/media/4651/download
sources.enbridge: Enbridge Gas Rate 1 (EGD rate zone) residential notice, rates effective 2026-10-01 — https://www.enbridgegas.com/-/media/Extranet-Pages/ontario/residential/myaccount/rates/EGD---Rate-1---System-Notice.pdf
sources.water: City of Niagara Falls 2026 Water and Wastewater Rates card — https://niagarafalls.ca/media/j0znyfgs/cnf_www_ratecard-2026_85x11-v2.pdf
sources.heating_fuel: Statistics Canada table 38-10-0286-01, Primary heating systems and type of energy, 2023 (Households and the Environment Survey)
sources.climate: Environment and Climate Change Canada, Canadian Climate Normals 1981-2010, station NIAGARA FALLS NPCSH (6135657) — https://api.weather.gc.ca/collections/climate-normals
sources.nrcan: Natural Resources Canada, Comprehensive Energy Use Database, Residential Sector, Ontario, 2022, tables 2, 5, 6, 10, 11, 12, 14, 24 — https://oee.nrcan.gc.ca/corporate/statistics/neud/dpa/menus/trends/comprehensive/trends_res_on.cfm
sources.shs: Statistics Canada table 11-10-0223-01, Survey of Household Spending 2023, Ontario, by before-tax income quintile

electricity_npei_residential_2026.note: Distribution is fully fixed for NPEI residential (no per-kWh distribution rate). Per-kWh lines are $/kWh. Riders expire 2026-12-31.

natural_gas_enbridge_rate1_egd_2026_10_0.note: Niagara Falls is in the Enbridge Gas Distribution (EGD) rate zone. Tier widths are m3 per month: first 30, next 55, next 85, over 170.

ontario_apartment_heating_system_stock_p.note: NRCan table 24: gas medium 9.3% + high efficiency 58.0%; electric 24.9%

ontario_utility_spending_2023_by_income_.note: Average per household across ALL households in the quintile, including those whose rent covers utilities and those with no gas service. $ per year.

derived_seasonal_shapes.method: gas month share = (1 - h) x days/365 + h x HDD share, h = space-heating share of residential gas use. Electricity in a gas-heated home = flat base + cooling by CDD share. Electrically heated homes add heating kWh by HDD share.

derived_dwelling_scaling_ontario_2022.census_mapping: single_detached = single-detached house; single_attached = semi-detached, row house, other single-attached; apartments = duplex apartment and both apartment-building classes

derived_example_gas_heated_home_monthly_.assumptions: Enbridge typical customer 2,400 m3/yr; NPEI reference 750 kWh/month average on the Tiered plan at 2026-11-01 prices; city-average water use 15 m3/month on a 5/8 inch meter. Bills include HST; electricity includes the 15.7% rebate. Gas excludes the one-time October 2026 refund.

derived_example_electrically_heated_home.assumptions: Ontario averages from NRCan 2022: non-heating electricity per household plus space-heating kWh per electrically heated household, heating spread by HDD share. NPEI Tiered plan at 2026-11-01 prices, HST and 15.7% rebate included. Same water bill.

data_gaps: Share of Niagara Falls renters whose rent includes heat and/or hydro is not published; the census shelter cost covers utilities whether paid directly or through rent.
No utility-specific average consumption for NPEI residential customers was retrieved; 750 kWh/month is the OEB reference customer for NPEI bill impacts.
Heating intensity by dwelling age: NRCan publishes space-heating energy by vintage but not households by vintage, so no per-home age index is included.
Electricity primary-heating share for the St. Catharines-Niagara CMA carries StatCan quality flag E.
Monthly shapes use 1981-2010 climate normals (latest published for the Niagara Falls station); a given year will differ.
